layer: Satellite-derived near-surface OSCAR field; nominal 15 m product coordinate, not a direct instrument slice or a depth-resolved measurement.
averaging: Equal-sample paired monthly means of all available source timestamps, with complete pairs required at each cell; not exact daily/time-weighted means or a climatology.
direction_definition: Direction of the paired monthly-mean vector at its selected eastward peak; not an average of per-frame headings.
speed_definition: Magnitude of that paired monthly-mean vector; not mean per-frame speed.
component_span_definition: First connected positive eastward component of the paired monthly-mean profile; not mean per-frame spans.
credit: ESR OSCAR version 2017.0, NOAA PIFSC ERDDAP mirror. Source license and citation retained verbatim in metadata.json. OSW derives monthly paired means and direction/column diagnostics.
